recent_articles.title: Karnataka CM swearing-in LIVE: D.K. Shivakumar to be sworn in as Karnataka CM - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **D.K. Shivakumar**, the eight-time legislator and **Karnataka Pradesh Congress Committee president**, will be sworn in as the 34th Chief Minister of Karnataka on Wednesday evening at Lok Bhavan. The event will also include prominent figures like **Rahul Gandhi**, **Mallikarjun Kharge**, and other **Congress Chief Ministers**.

recent_articles.title: Why Himachal local body poll results come as boost to BJP despite CM Sukhu’s ‘local factors’ argument | Political Pulse News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Saurabh Parashar**, an Assistant Editor at **The Indian Express**, focuses on the socio-political landscape of Himachal Pradesh, particularly environmental issues, drug menace, and governance challenges. He has over 17 years of experience in print media, specializing in crime, legal affairs, and investigative reporting.  His recent articles have explored the impact of policy on social safety nets, the conflict between development and forest conservation, and the unique challenges of governance in high-altitude regions. **Parashar** is known for his tenacious reporting on the state's drug epidemic and his deep understanding of Himachal Pradesh's geography and tribal culture.

recent_articles.title: Make dope tests mandatory for individuals joining govt services: Himachal Pradesh CM Sukhu | Chandigarh News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Himachal Pradesh** Chief Minister Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu directed all departments to implement mandatory drug testing for government service applicants.  He also requested details on action taken against employees involved in drug trafficking and sought information regarding vacant posts, pending gratuity payments, and applications for compassionate grounds employment. **Sukhu** emphasized the state's commitment to combatting drug abuse and ensuring timely removal of fallen trees from forest land following recent storms. The meeting was attended by various senior officials including Chief Secretary Sanjay Gupta and Additional Chief Secretaries K K Pant and Onkar Chand Sharma.

recent_articles.title: Congress govt. in Himachal changing election rules to hijack local body polls: BJP State chief - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rajeev Bindal**, **BJP Himachal Pradesh President**, accused the **Congress government** of attempting to manipulate urban local body and Panchayati Raj elections in the state. He claimed that the government amended election rules, granting deputy commissioners discretionary authority over meeting timings, and delaying the elections. Bindal argued this is an attempt to gain control over municipal councils and other bodies through political influence and money power, violating democratic principles and electoral laws.

recent_articles.title: Himachal urban poll results reflect public confidence in Congress; party united with no groupism, says CM Sukhu - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu**, Chief Minister of **Himachal Pradesh**, attributed the Congress-backed candidates' victory in recent urban local body elections to public approval of the party's governance. He highlighted the sustained popularity despite anti-incumbency pressures and emphasized a unified effort among party workers.  He also criticized the BJP for its perceived lack of support for Himachal Pradesh, particularly regarding issues like the Revenue Deficit Grant and natural disasters. Sukhu asserted that the Congress has fulfilled its promises and exceeded expectations in delivering on commitments such as welfare schemes and reforms in education and healthcare.

recent_articles.title: Suspected kidnapping bid on son of Himachal CM's aide, unknown persons booked - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Aryan Chauhan**, general secretary of the **Himachal Pradesh Youth Congress**, was targeted in an attempted kidnapping near Mashobra, Himachal Pradesh. While driving from his hotel to Shimla, he came into contact with two masked men who brandished a gun and metal rod.  Chauhan escaped injury after jumping out of his car and onto the side of the road. The police have booked unknown persons in connection with the incident but haven't specified the charges.

recent_articles.title: Himachal CM Sukhu presents ₹54,928-crore budget for 2026-27 - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Himachal Pradesh** Chief Minister Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu presented a ₹54,928-crore budget for the 2026-27 fiscal year in the state assembly.  Sukhu accused the **BJP** of not supporting the state's interests and criticized the discontinuation of the revenue deficit grant (RDG). The opposition **BJP** members reacted with slogans, prompting the speaker to adjourn the session. Sukhu announced a ₹500-crore allocation for completing pending works and increased milk procurement prices.

recent_articles.title: Himachal Pradesh’s growth in 2025-26 pegged at 8.3%, says economic survey - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Himachal Pradesh** Chief Minister Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu announced plans to invest ₹3,000 crore in the tourism sector. The government aims to promote green industries by constructing heliports and expanding Kangra Airport.  Sukhu also highlighted the development of a Bulk Drug Park at Haroli and emphasized streamlining industrial clearances for investors. The State's Economic Survey projected 8.3% economic growth in 2025-26, with a per capita income increase of 9.8%.  The survey also noted a rebound in tourist arrivals after the Covid-19 pandemic.

recent_articles.title: Himachal govt. intends to invest ₹3,000 crore in tourism; Chief Minister woos industry - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Himachal Pradesh** Chief Minister Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu announced plans to invest ₹3,000 crore in the tourism sector, aiming to promote green industries suited to the state's unique environment.  Sukhu urged industry leaders to invest in tourism, food processing, and information technology sectors, highlighting the government's support for these areas.  He also emphasized improvements to the single-window system for industry clearances and assured that harassment of industrialists would not be tolerated. The Chief Minister described Himachal Pradesh as a vital resource for the region and called for restoring financial assistance under Article 275(1) of the Constitution.
